fuelTitle: What fuel does my car need?
fuelBody: Know what to check before you fill up.
helpBody: Make sense of the signs at the pump.
promiseBody: If we don’t know, we’ll say so. No guessed fuel types or prices presented as live.
privacy: Location is requested only after you press “Use my location”. No precise-location storage or analytics transmission. Favorites store only station IDs and region codes in this browser.
sourcesBody: Stations come from OpenStreetMap via Geofabrik. Official prefectural fuel references come from Japan’s Agency for Natural Resources and Energy. Source dates and unknowns are shown; no live station prices or vehicle-fuel guesses.
footer: Made for the journey, wherever it takes you.
pageTitle: Japan fuel station map — Fuel Me Japan
description: Explore fuel stations in Japan on a map. Choose a prefecture or explicitly use your location, with dated references and honest unknowns.
ffNoJavaScript: Enable JavaScript to search for stations. You can still read this page and switch languages.
ffIntro: Find mapped fuel stations in Japan. Use your location, or choose a prefecture without sharing it.
ffLocationPrivacy: Only requested when you press this button. Kept in this panel’s memory; not saved or sent to analytics.
ffManualHelp: All 47 prefectures. No location permission needed.
ffStart: Choose how you’d like to find a station.
ffLocating: Waiting for your device’s location… You can choose a prefecture instead.
ffLoading: Loading and checking regional station data…
ffDenied: Location permission was denied. Choose a prefecture, or enable location in your browser and try again.
ffUnavailable: Your device’s location is unavailable. Choose a prefecture or try the location button again.
ffTimeout: Location took too long. Choose a prefecture or try the location button again.
ffOutside: This location is outside our Japan search area. Choose a Japanese prefecture to plan a stop.
ffLoadError: Station data could not be loaded or verified. Retry or choose another prefecture.
ffFilter: Filter by recorded name, city or address
ffFilterPlaceholder: Try a Japanese station name or city
ffFilterHelp: Searches only the loaded records’ names, brands, cities and addresses. Missing tags cannot be matched; this is not a place geocoder.
ffStraightLineHelp: Sorted by straight-line distance within 50 km. This is not driving distance or travel time; roads and access may differ.
ffNoDistance: Showing this prefecture’s mapped stations. Your location is not used, so no distance from you is shown.
ffNoResults: No matching station in this dataset. This does not mean there are no stations. Change your search or choose another prefecture.
ffCoverage: OpenStreetMap station data, distributed via Geofabrik. Coverage and details may be incomplete or outdated; confirm at the station.
ffHoursHelp: Based on recorded hours, not a live “open now” check. Date exceptions may override weekly hours. Confirm with the station.
ffFuelReminderTitle: Your vehicle’s fuel is not verified
ffFuelReminder: Check your rental documents and the vehicle’s fuel-door label before filling. Ask the rental company if unsure. A station’s fuel list does not identify what your car needs.
ffPaymentHelp: A recorded card brand does not guarantee acceptance of foreign-issued cards. Check with the station before filling.
ffPriceScope: A prefectural benchmark, not this station’s price or a live quote.
ffPriceUnit: Cash survey prices · tax included · JPY per litre
ffPriceError: Official reference prices could not be verified. Station search and navigation are still available.
ffStalePrice: Older reference: the survey is more than 14 days old. Check the source date and confirm prices at the station.
ffOfficialSource: Source: Agency for Natural Resources and Energy / METI — original survey workbook ↗
ffProcessed: Processed from the official survey: prefectural rows and three fuel categories extracted. This presentation is not government-endorsed.
ffNavigationHelp: Opens an external map in a new tab. Only the station destination is passed; the provider handles your route and location permission.
ffHoursUntranslated: This schedule contains rules we cannot reliably translate yet. The full original record is shown below; confirm with the station.
mapNearbyScope: Within 50 km of your requested location
mapOverviewHelp: Numbers are dataset record counts, not live availability or a complete station census. Summary points are region entry points, not station locations. Choose a prefecture to load its stations.
mapOverviewError: The regional index could not be verified. Retry or choose a prefecture.
mapPrivacy: The OpenStreetMap basemap service receives tile requests for the area you browse and usual network information, including your IP address and referring site. These requests can reveal the area being viewed. The map makes external requests even without device location permission.
mapKeyboardHelp: Use arrow keys to pan and plus or minus to zoom. Tab to map points and press Enter to select. All regions and stations are also accessible in List view.
mapUnavailable: The map could not be initialized. Region selection and the station list remain available.
mapTileError: Some basemap tiles failed to load. Station markers and the list remain available.
mapClusterMembers: {count} overlapping station records. Open member list.
mapRegionGroup: {regions} regions, {count} recorded stations. Zoom in to choose a region.
mapRegionChoices: {regions} regions share this summary point, with {count} records. Choose a region.
fpHelp: This changes the displayed fuel price only. It does not identify the correct fuel for your vehicle.
fpStorage: Your chosen fuel is remembered on this device. Your location is not saved.
fpComparison: Colors compare valid station quotes in the loaded results within the same prefecture, source, basis and observation day. At least 3 stations and 3 distinct prices are required; ties share a color. Filtering or moving the map does not change the baseline. Comparable quotes: {count}.
sfChooseRegion: Choose a region and wait for stations to load.
sfCountHelp: Counts show records in the full loaded area. Preview also includes your station search and all selected filters.
sfPaymentHelp: Only recorded acceptance is matched. Payment records are scarce; a station missing from these results may still accept this payment.
sfUnavailableHelp: These fields are not recorded in this dataset. Options are unavailable; this does not mean the service is absent.
lmNoPrices: No comparable station prices are available for this fuel. Stations remain browsable without a price ranking.
lmNotComparable: These station quotes cannot be compared on the same basis. No price ranking is applied.
lmPriceRanked: Valid prices for the selected fuel, lowest first. Only quotes from the same prefecture, source, tax-inclusive cash basis and Japan observation day are compared; stations without a valid quote follow.
lmNearestHint: Use the locate icon to sort by your distance. Selecting Nearest does not request your location.
lmStraightLineHelp: Distances are straight-line measurements within 50 km of your requested location, not driving distance or travel time.
lmFavoritesHelp: Your saved stations across all regions, in the order you saved them.
lmEmpty: No saved stations yet. Use a station’s star to save it.
lmNoMatch: No saved stations match this search and filters. Clear or adjust them to see your saved stations.
lmHiddenFavorites: Search or filters hide {count} saved stations. Clear or adjust them to show more.
lmLoadError: Your saved stations could not be loaded. Your favorites are still kept; retry or manage them below.
lmMissing: These saved entries are not in the current dataset. This does not confirm that the stations have closed. Retry or remove the saved entry.
lmNoAvailable: No saved station records are currently available. Your saved entries remain below the status message for retry or removal.
lmStorageError: Browser storage is unavailable. Favorites work in this page’s memory, but your changes may be lost on reload; previously saved entries may return.
lmStorageCorrupt: The stored favorites format is invalid and was not loaded. Saving a station will replace it with a new list.
lmLimit: You can save up to {count} stations. Remove a favorite before adding another.
lmStorageHelp: Up to 200 favorites are kept in this browser only. Your location is not saved, and favorites do not sync between devices. Station data is loaded for the relevant regions when you open Favorites. Clearing browser data removes your favorites.
mfHelp: Choose 1–3 fuels. Keep at least one selected.
myFuelGuidance: Before filling, check your rental documents and the fuel-door label. If they disagree or you are unsure, ask the rental company before filling.
myFuelLabelsHelp: Recognition guide only. These three labels do not identify the fuel your vehicle needs.
myFuelPreferenceHelp: Remembered on this device as the default fuel shown on the map. You can still select multiple fuels on the map. This is your display preference, not a verified vehicle fuel recommendation.
rgLightVehicle: A kei (light) car does not necessarily use diesel. 軽油 means diesel, not “fuel for light cars”.
rgStep1Body: Check the fuel-door label and rental contract. If they disagree or you are unsure, ask the rental company before filling.
rgStep2Title: Make it safe before opening the cap
rgStep2Body: Switch off the engine. No smoking or flames. Touch the static-discharge pad before opening the fuel cap, and follow the station’s safety notices.
rgStep3Body: Select the fuel you have checked and the amount or full-tank option. Payment order varies: follow the screen or ask an attendant.
rgStep4Title: Hold the nozzle; stop when it stops
rgStep4Body: Insert the nozzle fully and keep holding it while filling. Stop at the automatic shutoff; do not top up. If it repeatedly stops too early, ask an attendant.
rgStep5Body: Return the nozzle and close the fuel cap and door securely. Follow the station’s remaining payment steps and collect your receipt.
rgStaff: At a staffed station, ask the attendant to help you refuel.
rgMisfuelBody: Do not start the engine or switch on the vehicle’s power. Contact the attendant and rental company for help.
rgAttribution: Adapted and translated by Fuel Me Japan from Japan’s Fire and Disaster Management Agency (FDMA) materials.
rcFukuoka: Times · Fukuoka Airport International Terminal branch
rcCoverage: Only these three Times branches are covered. For another branch, return to the map to find fuel.
rcLocationHelp: Check the return branch on your booking, not the airport terminal. These coordinates are branch reference points, not verified entrances.
rcFuelHelp: For this return flow only. Check your contract and fuel-door label; this is not vehicle verification and does not change your map settings.
rcRules: Times standard terms require a full tank on return and may require a fuel receipt. Your own booking and contract take precedence.
rcStale: This information is at least 90 days old. Recheck the branch, return arrangements and fuel/receipt terms with Times before using it.
rcError: Return-branch data could not be loaded or verified. Retry or return to the map.
rcDistanceHelp: Candidates within 10 km of the return branch, ordered by straight-line distance. This is not driving distance, travel time or a route recommendation.
rcStationsError: Station data could not be loaded or verified. Retry or return to the map.
rcEmpty: No candidate in the recorded data for this fuel within 10 km. This does not mean no station exists. Return to the map to adjust your search.
rcUnknownSupply: Supply not recorded · confirm at the station
rcFuelReminder: Fuel selected for this stop: {fuel}. Confirm it against the fuel-door label and rental documents before filling.
rcNotDone: Opening navigation does not mark refuelling complete.
rcSourceScope: Branch details checked against Times information; two location points come from OpenStreetMap.
rcNavigationHelp: Opens an external map in a new tab. Only the selected destination is passed; the provider handles your route and location permission.
rdIntro: Search recorded rental locations in Japan, check your booked return address, then find nearby fuel stops.
rdCandidateHelp: Candidate records may be incomplete or out of date. They do not confirm opening hours, return eligibility or a vehicle entrance. Compare the address with your booking.
rdSearchLabel: Branch name, address or airport code
rdEmpty: No matching records. Try another area, company or name.
rdLoadingPlaceholder: No branches to display yet. Matching results will appear here once loading finishes.
rdVerified: Return facility checked against official source
rdMapUnavailable: Map unavailable; branch information remains available.
rdCluster: {count} rental records · zoom or choose a branch
rdNotFoundHelp: This address does not identify a current record. Search the rental directory to find your booked branch.
rdReferencePoint: The map shows a recorded branch or facility reference point. The vehicle entrance has not been checked on site; follow the branch’s vehicle-return instructions.
rdCounterHelp: This record is a reception counter, not a verified vehicle-return site. Return navigation is unavailable. Ask your rental company for the actual vehicle-return address.
rdScope: Official checks cover addresses and return arrangements for 19 facilities across seven airports: 7 Times, 6 Nippon and 6 Toyota. New facilities retain OSM/Overture map reference points, not verified vehicle entrances. This is not complete branch coverage.
rdContractRules: Confirm fuel level, receipt requirements and return eligibility with your own booking and rental contract. No branch-specific fuel policy has been verified here.
rdLicenseHelp: Derived database: ODbL 1.0. Original OSM and Overture attributions and source licenses are retained, including the full Foursquare NOTICE.
rdLimitedFacts: Rental companies: limited facts checked manually; summaries written for this guide.
rdDownloadHelp: Download all partitions, the index, source records, deduplication audit, notices and licenses. A record count is not a measure of complete national coverage.
rdConfirmAddress: I checked that this address matches the return location on my booking and the company’s vehicle-return instructions.
rental.airport.NRT: Return to the Kosuge branch. Terminal 1 and 2 counters are reception points; a branch shuttle is available after return.
rental.airport.HND: Vehicles cannot be returned at Haneda terminals. Return to the Haginaka branch at the recorded address, then use the shuttle.
rental.airport.KIX: Returns are handled by the Kansai Airport branch. Aeroplaza 2F is the counter floor, not a driving destination. Follow the branch’s vehicle-return instructions; the access bridge has tolls and related taxes.
rental.airport.NGO: Return to the shared pickup/return facility and follow staff directions. Access Plaza 1F is reception; use the airport’s official vehicle-return route, not walking directions to the counter.
rental.airport.CTS: Return to the Kashiwadai-minami branch, complete the return and take the shuttle. Terminal counters are not return sites. Ask staff before using the branch’s fuelling facility; do not enter the work area yourself.
rental.airport.FUK: Return to the Higashinaka branch, complete the return and take the shuttle to the international terminal. The terminal counter and bus stop are not vehicle-return sites.
rental.airport.OKA: Return to the Kagamizu branch. After completing the return, take the shuttle to Naha Airport. The airport shuttle pickup point is not a vehicle-return site.
rcCandidateMapHelp: Map of this page’s stations. Hover or focus a card to zoom in. The car icon marks the branch reference point, not a verified vehicle entrance.
rgIntro: Five steps for refuelling in Japan, common Japanese pump labels and safety reminders.
aboutIntro: Multilingual fuel information for driving in Japan: find stations, plan a refuelling stop before returning a rental car, and understand Japanese pump labels.
aboutMission: Language should not get in the way of your journey. Fuel Me Japan brings station maps, rental return information and refuelling guidance together for visitors driving in Japan and anyone looking for a fuel station. The site is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Thai.
aboutFindFuel: Explore stations on a map or in a list, filter by recorded information, check station details and save favorites. Choose your usual fuel manually in My Fuel.
aboutReturnCar: Search rental locations by region, company or branch name, check the recorded return information and browse nearby fuel stations.
aboutGuide: Read the five refuelling steps, recognize Japanese fuel and machine labels, and review the guidance for self-service stations.
aboutStationData: Fuel station records come from OpenStreetMap, using Japan extracts distributed by Geofabrik. Details such as opening hours, payment methods and fuel availability may be missing.
aboutRentalData: Rental location candidates combine OpenStreetMap and Overture Maps data. Return arrangements for selected airport facilities have also been checked against rental companies’ official information; each detail page shows its verification scope and date.
aboutPriceData: Prefectural reference prices come from Japan’s Agency for Natural Resources and Energy price survey. They are regional benchmarks, not individual station quotes. Live station prices are not currently available.
aboutLimits: Records may be incomplete or out of date. A listing does not confirm that a business is open or accepts rental returns, and a map point is not a verified vehicle entrance. Check local signs, your booking and your rental agreement.
aboutFuelSafety: My Fuel saves your manually selected display preference; it does not identify the fuel your vehicle needs. Check the fuel-door label and rental agreement.
aboutIndependent: Fuel Me Japan is an independent information project. It does not represent the fuel stations, rental companies or source organizations shown on the site.
aboutPrivacyTitle: Location, local settings and external services
aboutPrivacy: No account is required. Fuel preferences and station favorites are stored in the current browser and do not automatically sync across devices. The site requests location permission only when you press the location button. Precise location is not saved persistently or included in analytics events.
aboutMapsPrivacy: Loading a map sends tile requests and normal network information, including your IP address, to OpenStreetMap. These requests can reveal the area you are viewing.
aboutContactBody: Send us corrections to station or rental information, feedback on usability or accessibility, and enquiries about data licensing or collaboration.
aboutContactHelp: For a correction, please include the page link, station or branch name, and what needs to change.
aboutPriceSource: Agency for Natural Resources and Energy · price survey
brandCreditsBody: Logos identify the brands recorded in the source data; they do not imply a partnership, endorsement, or current affiliation. Each linked file page declares the displayed wordmark or simple geometric logo as PD-textlogo. Trademark rights remain with their owners. New files are displayed unchanged; the ENEOS and Cosmo symbols are extracted from the originals. Brands without a reviewed asset use the fuel-pump icon.
rental.shop.nippon-narita-airport: Return to the 取香495-2 branch, then take its shuttle to Terminal 1 or 2. Vehicles cannot be returned inside the airport. Terminal 3 passengers connect via Terminal 2.
rental.shop.nippon-haneda-airport: Return to the 羽田5-2-1 branch and follow staff arrangements for transfer to your terminal. Airport counters and the 羽田 support centre that may handle pickup must not be assumed to be return destinations.
rental.shop.nippon-kansai-airport: Park in the designated rental-car return spaces before completing the return at the Nippon counter on Aeroplaza 2F. The map shows a facility reference point; the upstairs counter is not a vehicle entrance.
rental.shop.nippon-chubu-centrair-airpor: Park in the designated return area, then settle the rental at the first-floor office. Walking directions from Access Plaza 2F to 1F are not a driving route; consult the airport’s official vehicle-return directions.
rental.shop.nippon-new-chitose-airport: Return to the 美々758-136 branch, then take the shuttle to the airport. Pickup and return are not available inside the terminals. Allow time according to your booking and the branch’s arrangements that day.
rental.shop.nippon-naha-airport-toyosaki: Return to the 豊崎3-95 branch; the shuttle goes to the domestic terminal’s third floor at Naha Airport. The official page asks for return two hours before scheduled departure. Roadworks and traffic can lengthen the transfer; check your booking arrangements.
rental.shop.toyota-haneda-airport-intern: Return to the international-terminal branch at 羽田1-15-11. Returns at the airport itself or outside branch opening hours are not accepted. The branch lists shuttle service to Terminals 2 and 3; do not confuse it with the Haneda domestic-terminal branch.
rental.shop.toyota-new-chitose-airport-p: Return to the Poplar (ポプラ) branch at 美々758-137, then follow staff arrangements for the shuttle to New Chitose Airport. Do not confuse it with Suzuran (すずらん). The official page lists closure on November 10; confirm your booking date before travel.
rdStale: This information is at least 90 days old. Recheck the branch, return arrangements and applicable fuel/receipt terms with your rental company before use.
rental.shop.toyota-narita-airport: Return to the Narita Airport branch at 取香530-13, not directly to a terminal. After the return procedure, follow the branch arrangements for the shuttle. For Terminal 3, transfer from Terminal 2 by airport shuttle bus or the connecting walkway.
rental.shop.toyota-chubu-centrair-airpor: The official return guide directs you to park beside the branch on the first floor of Access Plaza and use the rental-car entrance (レンタカー専用入口). The international departure counter in Terminal 1 and TOYOTA SHARE parking are not this branch’s return destination. Follow your booking and on-site signs. The map is a facility reference point.
rental.shop.toyota-fukuoka-airport-inter: The official page lists returns at the 福岡INTERNATIONAL branch at 東那珂2-22-3 and free shuttle service for Fukuoka Airport’s international terminal. The shared desk on the terminal’s first floor handles shuttle reception. Check your booked branch and the instructions for your return day. The map is a branch reference point; its vehicle entrance has not been verified.
rental.shop.toyota-naha-airport-seaside: Both current official branch pages list 与根50-132. Toyota specifies MAPCODE 33003370*73 for returns; check your booked branch and the instructions for your return day. The map retains a source reference point; the vehicle entrance has not been verified.
